about: The life of a plugin as the user sees it (rich-plugins 4.14, O-124), written by hand and never captured. The plugin is parity/plugins/life (TS) and its Rust twin in crates/tui/tests/all/plugin_machines.rs. An observation is line/palette/row: the plugin's line in home.footer (A, B or -), whether the palette finds its commands (yes or no), and its row in the plugin manager (on, off or failed). Actions: toggle is enter on its row in the plugin manager; flip, throw and arm run its palette commands Life flip, Life throw and Life arm. Life arm makes its next setup throw. TS is the specification: an enable whose setup throws shows the error in a toast and leaves the row as it was. A row in xfail is a known difference, [client, deviation file or finding:<name>, 'state action observation']; a finding is open and named in steps/plugins-pt.md.
